title: William Davenant
html_source:
Sir William Davenant, (born February 1606, Oxford, Eng.—died April 7, 1668, London), English poet, playwright, and theatre manager who was made poet laureate. Shakespeare was apparently Davenant’s godfather, and gossip held that the famous playwright may even have been his father.
Encyclopedia Britannica
